name: fetch
description: Fetch a URL, escalating to a real browser only if plain HTTP is blocked

args.name: timeout
args.help: Total budget in seconds across every tier

args.name: max-chars
args.help: Truncate content at this many characters (0 disables)

args.name: browser
args.help: Escalate to a real browser when the site blocks plain HTTP (--browser false to stop at HTTP)

args.name: wait
args.help: Seconds to wait after page load when escalating to the browser

name: fetch-browser
description: Fetch any web page in a real browser and export as Markdown

args.name: wait
args.help: Seconds to wait after page load

args.name: wait-for
args.help: CSS selector to wait for in the main document or same-origin iframes

args.name: wait-until
args.help: Readiness policy after navigation: domstable or networkidle

args.name: frames
args.help: Iframe handling mode: relevant same-origin, all-same-origin, or none

args.name: diagnose
args.help: Print render diagnostics (frames, empty containers, XHR/API-like requests) to stderr

args.name: stdout
args.help: Print markdown to stdout instead of saving to a file
